events.name: John Brown's Body w/s/g Sim Redmond Band
events.info: John Brown's Body is coming to Middle Ages Music Hall! The torch has been relit. After a few years away from the road and studio, John Brown's Body returns with a powerhouse lineup of longtime JBB players, including founding members Kevin Kinsella, Tommy Benedetti, and Lee Hamilton. Celebrating 30 years of original roots reggae, JBB helped define the American reggae sound with their signature blend of roots, dub, powerful songwriting, deep grooves, and horn-driven energy. From the legendary All Time to chart-topping releases like Amplify and Kings And Queens, John Brown's Body has built a legacy that helped shape the modern U.S. reggae scene. Don't miss the return of one of the true OGs of American reggae live at Middle Ages Music Hall. Tickets on sale now!

events.name: Keller Williams
events.info: Get ready, Syracuse --- Keller Williams is coming to Middle Ages Music Hall on Saturday, October 3rd! Known as a true musical mad scientist, Keller brings his one-of-a-kind solo looping show to the stage, building songs live from scratch with nothing pre-recorded. Expect whimsical lyrics, wild guitar work, and a genre-bending mix of folk, funk, rock, bluegrass, and groovy electronica --- or as Keller calls it, , "rdquo" -> acoustic dance music." No two Keller shows are ever the same. Don't miss this one. #kellerwilliamsmusic #hippiesforthewin #kellerwilliamsmusician #freekerbythespeaker #kellerwilliams

events.name: House Party. A sweaty love-letter to the 2010s rager.
events.info: After Dark Presents House Party. A sweaty love-letter to the 2010s rager. Party with hundreds of your closest friends at House Party. The chaos and thrill of a 2010s rager. Louder, sweatier, and no neighbors to shut it down. Mid-2000s anthems, bloghouse, your skinniest jeans, and the kind of night that feels like it's happening in a thousand blurry photos. The soundtrack? LMFAO, Skrillex, A$AP Rocky, Swedish House Mafia, Passion Pit, Rihanna, MGMT + more. The soundtrack of nights you wish you could remember. (Or maybe forget.) Shutter shades. Neon bracelets. Disposable cameras. A little reckless, but never forced. This isn't nostalgia. This is muscle memory. Age Restriction: 21+ Admitted with ID
